newsitem.title: LEBANON: Zaire rebels agree to release Lebanon hostages.
newsitem.headline: Zaire rebels agree to release Lebanon hostages.

text.p: Zairean rebels have agreed to release 46 Lebanese nationals held as hostages under a deal organised by Beirut's embassies in Zaire and South Africa, a Lebanese official said on Sunday.

"The rebels and officials from our embassies in South Africa and Zaire reached an agreement on Saturday under which 46 Lebanese hostages would be released any time today," Haitham Jomaa, director general at the Ministry of Emigrants told Reuters.
Beirut newspapers recently reported that Zairean rebels took 65 Lebanese hostage, demanding a ransom of nearly $1 million.

There are 5,000 registered Lebanese nationals in the troubled Central African country where rebels seized the most important cities outside the capital as well as the richest mining provinces. Most of the Lebanese there are traders.
In a related development, a charter plane carrying 105 Lebanese citizens evacuated from Zaire landed in Beirut on Sunday, Beirut airport officials said.
They said passengers on board of the Air Congo plane, leased by the Lebanese government, were mostly women and children.
